tools.name: service_info
tools.description: Free. Describes this paid website-audit service: the three products, their prices, and exactly how to pay with x402 (USDC on Base). Call this first if you do not know how to pay.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Free preview of a website audit: 3 of 9 checks (HTTP status, robots policy, latency, agent-readiness score). Use it to see the shape of the result before paying. Returns JSON.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_site · Public sink: deep_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_site · Public sink: deep_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
